parameters.query:
WITH post_info AS (
  SELECT fs.fb_message 
  FROM estate_facebook_stats fs 
  WHERE ('{{ $json.fb_code }}' != '' AND (fs.fb_permalink ILIKE '%' || '{{ $json.fb_code }}' || '%' OR fs.fb_post_id ILIKE '%' || '{{ $json.fb_code }}' || '%'))
     OR ('{{ $json.long_fb_id }}' != '' AND (fs.fb_permalink ILIKE '%' || '{{ $json.long_fb_id }}' || '%' OR fs.fb_post_id ILIKE '%' || '{{ $json.long_fb_id }}' || '%'))
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(ep.id, 0) AS id,
  to_jsonb(ep.*) AS raw_row,
  to_jsonb(rp.*) AS advisor_row,
  pt.name        AS tipo_propiedad,
  (SELECT fb_message FROM post_info) AS fb_post_message
FROM (SELECT 1) dummy
LEFT JOIN estate_property ep ON (
  -- 1. Por código corto O por el ID largo numérico del post resuelto del redireccionamiento
  (('{{ $json.fb_code }}' != '' OR '{{ $json.long_fb_id }}' != '') AND (
      EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM estate_advisor_fb_post fb 
          WHERE fb.property_id = ep.id AND (fb.url ILIKE '%' || '{{ $json.fb_code }}' || '%' OR ('{{ $json.long_fb_id }}' != '' AND fb.url ILIKE '%' || '{{ $json.long_fb_id }}' || '%'))
      )
      OR EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM estate_facebook_stats fs 
          WHERE fs.property_id = ep.id AND (
                 fs.fb_permalink ILIKE '%' || '{{ $json.fb_code }}' || '%' 
              OR fs.fb_post_id ILIKE '%' || '{{ $json.fb_code }}' || '%'
              OR ('{{ $json.long_fb_id }}' != '' AND (fs.fb_permalink ILIKE '%' || '{{ $json.long_fb_id }}' || '%' OR fs.fb_post_id ILIKE '%' || '{{ $json.long_fb_id }}' || '%'))
          )
      )
  ))
  OR
  -- 2. Coincidencia por título/nombre con el título extraído del scraping o del mensaje
  ('{{ $json.extracted_title }}' != '' AND (
      COALESCE(to_jsonb(ep.*)->>'title', '') ILIKE '%' || '{{ $json.extracted_title }}' || '%'
   OR COALESCE(to_jsonb(ep.*)->>'name',  '') ILIKE '%' || '{{ $json.extracted_title }}' || '%'))
  OR
  -- 3. Coincidencia por las 2 palabras clave principales extraídas del mensaje o link (ej: 'rio' y 'amarillo')
  ('{{ $json.keywords[0] || "--" }}' != '--' AND '{{ $json.keywords[1] || "--" }}' != '--'
   AND (COALESCE(to_jsonb(ep.*)->>'title','') ILIKE '%' || '{{ $json.keywords[0] }}' || '%'
     OR COALESCE(to_jsonb(ep.*)->>'name','')  ILIKE '%' || '{{ $json.keywords[0] }}' || '%')
   AND (COALESCE(to_jsonb(ep.*)->>'title','') ILIKE '%' || '{{ $json.keywords[1] }}' || '%'
     OR COALESCE(to_jsonb(ep.*)->>'name','')  ILIKE '%' || '{{ $json.keywords[1] }}' || '%'))
  OR
  -- 4. Coincidencia parcial si la primera y segunda palabra clave fuerte coinciden en el título/sector (ej: 'rio amarillo')
  ('{{ $json.keywords[0] || "--" }}' != '--' AND '{{ $json.keywords.join(" ") }}' != '' AND (
      COALESCE(to_jsonb(ep.*)->>'title','') ILIKE '%' || '{{ $json.keywords.slice(0,2).join(" ") }}' || '%'
   OR COALESCE(to_jsonb(ep.*)->>'name','')  ILIKE '%' || '{{ $json.keywords.slice(0,2).join(" ") }}' || '%'))
)
LEFT JOIN res_users   ru ON ru.id = (to_jsonb(ep.*)->>'user_id')::int
LEFT JOIN res_partner rp ON rp.id = ru.partner_id
LEFT JOIN estate_property_type pt ON pt.id = (to_jsonb(ep.*)->>'property_type_id')::int
ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(to_jsonb(ep.*)->>'state','') = 'available' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,
  ep.id DESC
LIMIT 1;
